EmailTemplate.subject: Tonight's the night in San Diego!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Tonight's the night in San Diego! Don't forget to join us in just a few hours for an incredible evening overlooking San Diego Bay!
The Flywire team, along with Revecore, Cedar, Clearbalance, and Kodiak Solutions, can't wait to welcome you with premium cocktails, gourmet appetizers, and exciting hourly giveaways.
‌
When: Tonight | 5:30 PM - 9:30 PM PST ‌
Where: Coasterra 880 Harbor Island Dr, San Diego, CA 92101 Complimentary shuttle service is running from the Sheraton San Diego's front portico to Coasterra all evening.
See you in a few hours for what promises to be an unforgettable night!
